name: Robotics and Engineering Design
title: Robotics and Engineering Design
answer: Robotics and engineering design give students real problems to solve with their hands, and AI can support that work as a troubleshooting partner rather than a solution machine. The learning happens when students test, fail, and revise their own designs, so the teacher's job is to keep the challenge real and the thinking with the students.

sections.body: Robotics and engineering design put students in front of problems that do not work the first time, such as a robot that will not turn or a bridge that collapses. In those moments students have to investigate why, which is where the learning happens. AI can serve as a troubleshooting partner by asking what the student has already checked and suggesting what to test next, while the student does the testing. The idea solves the problem of students getting stuck or giving up, without taking the thinking away from them. It also gives structure to open ended engineering work so that students can move through it without being told what to build.
sections.heading: The idea

sections.body: In a classroom, a teacher can use AI to draft scaffolds for each stage of an engineering design challenge: defining the problem, brainstorming, choosing a design, building, testing, and improving. These scaffolds support students who get stuck without dictating the final product. Students can also use digital tools such as Tinkercad to design and test ideas before building them physically. The text does not give separate grade band examples, so the same structure applies across ages with the level of challenge adjusted by the teacher. Throughout, the student does the testing and the revising, because that is where the learning happens.
sections.heading: How it works in school

sections.body: The text does not present a study, figure, or formal evidence label for this idea. It rests on practice rather than research, describing how troubleshooting partnerships, staged scaffolds, and digital design tools work in engineering projects. The claim that failure and revision teach more than first try success is stated as the book's position, not as a cited finding.
sections.heading: What the evidence says

sections.body: The main risk is that AI removes the struggle by handing students a design that is sure to work, which would undercut the purpose of the project. The text is clear that AI should never do this, and that the value of these projects lies in failure and revision. The teacher's role is to keep the challenge real and the thinking with the students, which means deciding when to offer a scaffold and when to let students work through a problem. The student keeps responsibility for testing and improving the design, and the teacher keeps responsibility for the integrity of the challenge.
